Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

I read the complete diff, issue #4032 and the current laws from `git show upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.
The new check reads all non-adjacent guide pairs before any band is generated.
The padded box checks preserve possible meets for the exact segment solve.
The existing adjacent checks and their order stay in the band loop.
The reproduction is refused at `(8, 0, 2)`. The clean three-guide set still machines.

## Local results

Host: `wopr`, Linux. Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-4174`.
Base: `upstream/main` at `12ea01a45eccfc5c4cd221834eeb7d3e0400f806`.
The merge reported `Already up to date`: main is the parent of the PR head.
Thus the trial merge has no merge commit. HEAD is the reviewed PR head; HEAD^1 is main.
No runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 41 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 10.4 minutes.
- Motion: 875 passed, 29 ignored, across 21 test targets.
- App: 238 passed, 10 ignored, across 18 test targets.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 11 light tests passed; 12.2 minutes.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

## Extra suites run

The quick gate ran these full suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `rotary_flow`: 16 passed, 1 ignored. Both new integration pins passed.

No fixture, golden, or importer changed. The extra STEP suites do not apply.
No golden or recorded program moved. There are no moved golden lines to inspect.
No UI file changed. Screenshots do not apply.
Full heavy lanes were not run, under the current main's P3 review rule.

## Mutations run locally

1. I repeated the body's adjacent-only mutation in `rotary_flow_cross.rs`.
   Both crossing pins failed with exit 101:
   `multiaxis::rotary_flow_cross::tests::a_crossing_between_non_adjacent_chains_is_refused_by_name`
   and `bands::a_crossing_between_non_adjacent_guides_is_refused_by_name`.
   The unit check returned `Ok(())`; the kernel check returned a machined `Toolpath`.
2. I also bypassed the new `refuse_crossed_set` call in `rotary_flow.rs`.
   The kernel crossing pin failed with exit 101 because it returned a machined `Toolpath`.

I restored both files. Both crossing pins then passed, one test each.
The worktree has no tracked changes. No code, evidence, or image was committed or pushed.
The worktree and branch remain for the next review round.
